title: Preload 500 PIONEX candles through the working chart data source; then page deeper history
changes: Core app.js now contains a real selected-chart 500-candle preload, not merely a delayed history Worker request.

1D and 4H selected charts fetch 500 PIONEX candles using the verified existing chart data transport (PIONEX TradingView for crypto, existing Pionex REST/Worker for tokenized assets), retaining regular 95/130 background requests.
4H can continue through PIONEX TradingView candle-history growth (1000, 1500, ...) before falling back to Pionex REST endTime and shared 429 cooldown.
Workspaces show retained history count when the source updates; unchanged CoinGlass/RR/indicators/WebSocket.
Same-exchange time-sorted data is merged by timestamp without altering existing drawing anchors.
The timeframe heading now displays actual loaded 1D/4H candle counts and the earliest date is available in its tooltip.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite six files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar. Existing Worker must still support PIONEX TradingView chart WS for 500-bar preload and endTime for additional pages.
validationNote: Local Chromium/Node tests only; cannot verify live Pionex/Cloudflare endpoint in sandbox.
